description: This file contains C# classes related to code generation testing within the 'UnitTests.Grains' namespace. It defines a simple POCO class and a test class implementing a generic factory interface with an asynchronous method.

classes.name: CodeGenTestPoco
classes.description: A plain old CLR object with an integer property, used for testing code generation.

classes.name: FeaturePopulatorCodeGenTestClass
classes.description: A test class extending CodeGenTestPoco and implementing a generic IFactory interface, with an async Product method.

methods.name: Product
methods.description: Asynchronous method implementing the IFactory interface, delays for 100ms and returns the input value.
